subject: Davis R Users Group Fall 2022 announcement

messages.author: 532359cb4f30370a
messages.subject: Davis R Users Group Fall 2022 announcement
parts:
Greetings D-RUGgies!

The Davis R Users' Group is returning from summer hiatus and resuming our regular meetings Wednesdays 10am-noon in the Datalab classroom on the third floor of Shields Library (room 360!) Meetings resume the first Wednesday of the Fall quarter (Sept. 21) with a short presentation from yor coordinators followed by a work group for the remainder of the time.

A D-RUG work group is an unstructured time to ask and answer questions from the community, or simply work in company with other R enthusiasts. You can join by Zoom, as well.

D-RUG maintains a Discourse site where you can post questions for the D-RUG community and get answers outside of the regular Wednesday meetings. We recommend posting your questions there even if you are coming on Wednesday, because the questions and answers represent a knowledge base that folks can refer back to in the future.

The discourse site is d-rug.discourse.io. Details for joining the Wednesday meetings via Zoom will be sent out with the weekly announcements. We look forward to seeing you in the new quarter!

Finally, the Datalab is hosting a four-day workshop for members of the UC Davis community who want to get up to speed on R and/or to other tools like shell scripting, Git, and Github. That workshop will be held NEXT WEEK, Sept. 12 to Sept 15 (Mon-Thurs). Details and a link to register are at:
https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-collaborative-and-reproducible-research-practices-with-r-part-1-of-4/

Best,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
